clauses.statement: Public issue 1: the Error branch of _structuredClone now calls seen.set(value, e) before recursing into cause, so cycles resolve to the clone and shared Errors keep one clone. Observed: the static probe now reports 'records seen before cause recursion: True'. It then crashes with ValueError because the Object.create(getPrototypeOf) text it searches for was removed, so its exit code is nonzero. That is a probe limitation, not a runtime result. No JS engine was run on the cycle.

Public issue 2: plain objects are now built on {} (Object.prototype) and string keys are copied with Object.defineProperty (writable, enumerable, configurable). An own __proto__ key becomes an own data property and no setter runs. Arrays still start from []. Observed only statically: the probe no longer finds the old Object.create text. Not verified at runtime.
The existing structured_clone_crypto_parity tests (ArrayBuffer, DataView, CryptoKey, function/symbol rejection) passed after the change: 4 passed, 0 failed.

Unresolved: class instances without a clone hook now clone onto Object.prototype, which matches Chrome per the issue but was not runtime-tested. Symbol-keyed properties are still copied by assignment, and Error constructor and name handling are unchanged. No JS engine was available to run the cycle or __proto__ cases.
